fact: Radio Okapi reports that Kinshasa's provincial Interior Minister launched on 4 November 2025 a project to digitise the Kinshasa population register, with census agents collecting household data into a compilation server, supported by UNICEF among partners.
system: registre de la population de Kinshasa

fact: ONIP's legal expert described the FGP as the single reference for identifying individuals, covering Congolese and foreigners resident and Congolese abroad.

ONIP, created in 2011, was entrusted with building the general population file (fichier général de la population), and a 2022 decree organised identification and census operations, per BBC News Afrique.
Belgium (Brussels) funded a USD 43,262 pilot project in 2024 to give the commune of Kintambo in Kinshasa a digital, secured population register linked to the Ville-Province.
